content.title: Knicks vs Warriors Game Notes: March 15, 2026 | New York Knicks
content.text: The Knicks will tip off against the Golden State Warriors at 8:00PM ET. (TV: NBC/PEACOCK; RADIO: 880 ESPN NEW YORK)This Day in Knicks History:March 15, 1953: Harry Gallatin records a 30/30 game with 30 points and 33 rebounds, setting a franchise record for most rebounds in a single-game in 81-69 loss at Fort Wayne Pistons. (Note: Willis Reed would tie the mark on Feb. 2, 1971 vs. CIN). Last game vs GSW:San Francisco (1/15/26) – The New York Knicks fell to the Golden State Warriors, 126-113. Karl-Anthony Towns led New York with 17 points, a season-high 20 rebounds, two assists, one steal and one block. OG Anunoby scored 25 points, four rebounds, one assist and one steal. Miles McBride tied a season-high with 25 points on 56.3-percent shooting, six assists and three rebounds. Jimmy Butler III led Golden State with 32 points on 63.6-percent shooting, eight rebounds, four assists and two steals. Stephen Curry followed with 27 points on 58.8-percent shooting, seven assists, three rebounds, one steal and one block. Brandin Podziemski registered 19 points on 88.9-percent shooting, five rebounds, two assists and two steals off the bench. Connections: Knicks head coach Mike Brown served as an assistant coach on the Golden State Warriors (2016-22) and won three NBA Championships (2017-18 ,2022)...Warriors guard Stephen Curry scored a career-high 54 points in a loss against the Knicks on February 27, 2013 at Madison Square Garden…Curry also broke Reggie Miller’s record for most three-pointers made in a career on December 14, 2021 at Madison Square Garden...Warriors forward Jimmy Butler was teammates with Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns on the Minnesota Timberwolves for two seasons (2017-19)…Knicks guard Josh Hart and Warriors guard Gary Payton II were teammates on the Los Angeles Lakers in 2018 and the Portland Trail Blazers during part of the 2022-23 season...Knicks assistant coach Darren Erman served as an assistant coach on the Warriors for three seasons (2011-14)…Warriors guard Seth Curry was teammates with Knicks guard Jalen Brunson on the Dallas Mavericks during the 2019-20 season and Knicks guard Mikal Bridges on the Brooklyn Nets for part of the 2022-23 season...Knicks guard Mikal Bridges and Warriors guard De’Anthony Melton played together on the Phoenix Suns for one season (2018-19). Last Game:The New York Knicks defeated the Indiana Pacers, 101-92. Jalen Brunson led New York with 29 points, nine assists, five rebounds and one steal. Mitchell Robinson recorded 12 points on 60.0-percent shooting, a career-high 22 rebounds, two steals and two blocks. OG Anunoby scored 25 points on 50.0-percent shooting, eight rebounds and five assists. Jarace Walker led Indiana with 18 points, nine rebounds, three assists and one steal. Ivica Zubac added 11 points on 55.6-percent shooting, eight rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block. T.J. McConnell had 10 points on 55.6-percent shooting, six assists and three rebounds off the bench. MITCH GRABS CAREER-HIGH 22 REBOUNDS IN INDIANA: Mitchell Robinson recorded 12 points on 60.0-percent shooting, a career-high 22 rebounds, two steals and two blocks against Indiana (March 13). This marks his fourth career game with a 20-rebound double-double. This also marks his 17th career game with a double-double and two or more steals and blocks, which passes Bob McAdoo for second in franchise history. Jalen Brunson recorded 29 points, nine assists, five rebounds and one steal against Indiana (March 13). This marks his 40th game of the season scoring 25+ points, which ranks sixth in the NBA. OG Anunoby recorded 25 points on 50.0-percent shooting, eight rebounds and five assists against Indiana (March 13). This marks his second career game with 25+ points on 50.0-percent shooting or better, five or more rebounds and five or more assists- both coming this season.
